root.label: Met July briefing on Fayed trafficking survivors

events.label: Met July briefing on Fayed trafficking survivors

slots.name: trafficking-marked accounts
slots.sentence: In a briefing for the all-party parliamentary group (APPG) for the survivors of Fayed and Harrods in July, senior Met officers said a review earlier this year found 70 survivors’ accounts bore the hallmarks of trafficking.

slots.name: confirmed survivors
slots.sentence: The Home Office has confirmed that at least five survivors were victims of international and domestic trafficking.
